Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in Homo sapiens assays against target CHEMBL3880. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, and join assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter where target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3880' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Require structures by inner joining compound_structures on molregno. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
